biomarkers.name: CDC73 (HRPT2)
biomarkers.prevalence: Common in parathyroid carcinoma; reported in a substantial subset of cases (somatic and/or germline), with germline variants characteristic of hyperparathyroidism-jaw tumour syndrome
biomarkers.clinical_use: Diagnostic support; genetic counselling/testing if germline suspected; adverse prognostic association in some series

biomarkers.name: Parafibromin (encoded by CDC73)
biomarkers.prevalence: Loss of nuclear staining is frequent in parathyroid carcinoma
biomarkers.clinical_use: IHC surrogate for CDC73 inactivation; supports distinction of carcinoma from adenoma, though not entirely specific

biomarkers.name: Ki-67
biomarkers.prevalence: Often elevated relative to adenoma; no single validated diagnostic cutoff
biomarkers.clinical_use: Adjunct only; higher proliferative index may support malignancy and worse prognosis but does not by itself distinguish carcinoma from adenoma

biomarkers.name: PTH
biomarkers.clinical_use: Diagnosis of functional hyperparathyroidism; monitoring of residual/recurrent disease burden

biomarkers.name: Serum calcium
biomarkers.clinical_use: Clinical monitoring; severe hypercalcaemia is a common presenting and potentially lethal feature

histomorphological_subtype.primary_pattern: Trabecular, nested, or solid growth with dense fibrous bands; diagnosis rests on unequivocal invasive growth (capsular, vascular, soft tissue, or perineural invasion) and/or metastasis rather than cytology alone
histomorphological_subtype.grading: Requires unequivocal invasion (capsular, vascular, soft tissue, or perineural) or metastasis for diagnosis

tumor_microenvironment.stromal_features: Thick fibrous bands dividing tumour into lobules; hyalinised stroma

cellular_states_and_lineage.developmental_lineage: Endoderm — third (inferior) and fourth (superior) pharyngeal pouches
cellular_states_and_lineage.differentiation_state: Usually retains chief cell differentiation with PTH production; hypercalcaemia is common but not universal
cellular_states_and_lineage.lineage_plasticity: CDC73 loss (encoding parafibromin) is a hallmark molecular event in many cases; loss of parafibromin nuclear IHC supports the diagnosis
